name: io.github.cyanheads/openstreetmap-mcp-server
description: Geocode, reverse geocode, and run Overpass spatial queries on OpenStreetMap data.

environmentVariables.name: OSM_NOMINATIM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Nominatim API base URL. Override to use a private or mirror instance.

environmentVariables.name: OSM_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: User-Agent sent to Nominatim and Overpass. Required by usage policy.

environmentVariables.name: OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Overpass API endpoint URL. When set, pins every query to this one endpoint and disables mirror failover; OSM_OVERPASS_MAX_CONCURRENCY sizes it and a |N suffix is rejected. Leave unset to use OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS.

environmentVariables.name: OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated ordered list of Overpass endpoints. A failure advances to the next entry within the same tool call; a single entry means no failover. An entry written url|N gets N slots of its own and adds capacity, for an instance whose operator allows parallel queries, never a public FOSSGIS server; an unsuffixed later entry is failover only. Write a | inside a URL as %7C. Verify a mirror's usage policy, data coverage, and freshness before adding it. Ignored when OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL is set.

environmentVariables.name: OSM_OVERPASS_MAX_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Concurrent Overpass queries per endpoint: OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL, and every OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS entry not sized with |N. With no |N entry it is also the most queries in flight across all endpoints. A query waits at most 30 seconds in total for a slot, then fails with pacer_shed and a retryAfter. The default of 1 follows the public FOSSGIS instances, which allow one query in flight per user; raise it only for an instance whose operator allows parallel queries, such as a private or paid one.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public origin override for deployments behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy (e.g. https://mcp.example.com).
